plan.notes: The Lighthouse Ledger isn't in Qloo, so this plan uses The Thursday Murder Club (#1) and The Quiche of Death (Agatha Raisin, #1) as signals, plus Richard Osman and Marion Chesney (M.C. Beaton's real name) for authors. The median book popularity was about 0.774, and 6 of the 8 comps sit below it. All the high-priority title targets come from that less crowded half. The data is live, not sample. The regions are Cotswold and Midlands towns rather than Cornwall, because Qloo returned no Cornish places. Your Cornish setting is a way to stand out, not proof that readers live there. Many low-popularity titles are late Agatha Raisin books: they're cheap to target but have small audiences, so give them modest bids and check results after two weeks. Some author matches, such as Alexander Armstrong, Guy Walters and Greg Jenner, are broadcasters rather than mystery writers, so they were left out.
